name: San Leandro Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: You help library staff run programs for younger kids, or help with kit assembly, shelving and displays. You work one shift of 2 to 3 hours a week.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 9 to 12 who can commit to a regular weekly shift for at least 4 months. You must attend one orientation each school year.
deadline_text: Winter/spring applications are open now and due Dec 12, 2026. The required in-person orientation is Saturday, Dec 12 at 11:00 am at the Main Library. Summer applications open again in mid March 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online by Dec 12, 2026. Go to the in-person training at the Main Library. Turn in the forms you get there. Then pick a weekly or monthly shift for at least 4 months. If you helped before, use your old MyImpact login.
notes: The page heading says January 2026 to May 2027, which looks like a typo for January 2027. Even past volunteers must attend orientation. The page says a teen should handle their own emails, because the program is meant to prepare you for a first job. Senior volunteers can be eligible for a Friends of the Library scholarship. Questions: SBehimehr@sanleandro.org.
